title: VS Code in 1.30: queued work, real cancel, CLI you can find
focus: How the new chat panel surfaces tool calls as a queued, running, done checklist with plain English labels and live Open Diff buttons, why Escape and the nanocoder.cancel command now reliably tear down the in-flight request and clear pending approvals, how session renaming rides on a new renameSession ACP extMethod, and what changed in CLI discovery so Windows, NVM, Volta, fnm, pnpm, and bun users can actually start the extension.
